reason: It's free and Microsoft sign-in is easy, so I'd install it day one, but that's true of every app I try and I delete most within a week. The portal already has the deadlines; I missed one last semester because I wasn't checking, and another app I'd mute notifications on won't fix that.
objection: My college portal works fine, so this is just a second place for the same info, and its alerts will end up muted along with everything else.
would_change_my_mind: If its alerts actually caught a deadline or exam change I'd otherwise have missed in the first week or two, I'd keep it.
